item.tib: sangs rgyas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa las bsnyen thabs rin chen gser zhags ser po
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa'i (pas) lcags po (pho) khyi yi lo la shar phyogs/ rgyal mo rong gi nub phyogs 'jam dpal gshin rje bzhad pa'i gnas khro chu'i brag nas drangs te rab bstan phag gi lor rong chen dbang gi rgyal po gdan sa bsam 'grub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'grub par gyur cig//
